title: Fri 30 Oct 2026: ECB holds as Lagarde announces early exit, Alphabet rout hits Wall Street, FCA presses on financial crime
summary: The ECB holds its deposit rate at two point five percent while Christine Lagarde says she will leave in February twenty twenty seven, and Alphabet's slump ends Wall Street's winning run despite strong American growth. We cover the FCA's push against tickbox compliance, financial crime and crypto promotions, plus the latest on private markets redemptions. Three COO action points and the diary for the week ahead.
